summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required and secret fields, Airflow field mapping, and a profile property that sets auth_type to oauth and env-var references for client_secret and client_id). Exported it from cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/__init__.py, and registered it directly after DatabricksTokenProfileMapping in profile_mappings. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claiming, token-versus-OAuth selection, profile output, override protection, and env vars. Tests were not run, per instructions; expected values were checked by reading the base class. Nothing was committed.
